paragraphs: The X3 M50 xDrive uses the B58 — BMW's 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine. The G45-generation X3, launched for model year 2025, represents a full redesign of the X3 rather than a facelift of the previous G01 generation. The B58 fitted to the G45 M50 xDrive is a revised version of BMW's well-regarded 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-six, which has a strong reputation for reliability. The X3 M50 xDrive is the current six-cylinder performance-oriented variant in the X3 range, positioned above the four-cylinder X3 30 xDrive.
about.boldParagraph: The X3 M50 xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
